First public release.

Blocks the top-edge status bar peek while a game you picked is on screen. Works on HyperOS, no root. The bottom swipe to Home keeps working.

**Features**
- Per-app lock with an app picker (search, system-app filter)
- Overlay apps that keep the lock on (Game Turbo by default, manual package entry)
- Start / Stop, a Quick Settings tile with an in-app "Add tile" button, and a notification Stop action
- One-tap setup with Shizuku, or grant the permissions with adb
- Restores the normal value on stop, screen lock, crash, update and boot
- Start after reboot
- Material You UI with an adaptive themed icon
- No internet permission, no analytics

**Install:** download `StatusBarLock-v0.0.1.apk` below, then follow the Set up section in the README.

If you built the app yourself before, tap **Stop**, uninstall that build, then install this one. It's signed with a different key.
